# Loyalife by Xoxoday

> Loyalife by Xoxoday is an enterprise loyalty and incentives platform for customer, channel partner and influencer programs. Every rule is approved, every point is traceable.

Facts as of 2026-10-03. Figures marked "to be confirmed" in CONFIRM.md need confirmation before they are quoted.

## Who it serves
Loyalty heads, marketers, finance and risk leads and partner managers at global enterprises. First priority market: the US.

## Key facts
- 65M+ members managed; $5B+ rewards distributed to date
- 150+ countries with localized rewards; 30+ languages; 55+ currencies
- Rewards marketplace of 10M+ options in 30+ categories
- 99.99% platform uptime, SLA backed
- Launch to first redemption in 8 to 12 weeks versus 9 to 12 months for an in house build
- Program types: enterprise multi brand, channel, influencer, omnichannel, coalition
- Multi-tenant: each program runs independently under one account
- White label iOS and Android app; WhatsApp bot to check balance, browse and redeem
- Deployment: on-prem, hybrid and cloud; VPC; Active-Active DR
- Security: PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, dual-control, audit and ML fraud
- Governance: maker checker approvals, audit trail, idempotent and replayable reward ledger, anomaly detection
- APIs: REST-first; OAuth 2.0 to JWT for members, transactions and points
